description.zh: 对照原手册带引线的具体色码与窗口字段。 Just Color Picker是AnnyStudio提供的Windows与macOS离线取色及调色软件，官网用主窗口示例和手册说明色码、色表与渐变功能。官方二进制免费，合规商用须遵守版权和用途限制，程序制作源码与其许可未确认。
description.en: Just Color Picker is an offline color picker and editor for Windows and macOS. Its official page presents a main-window example, color-code formats, palettes and a detailed manual. The binary is freeware under custom copyright and use conditions; production-source availability and licensing remain unconfirmed.
